ctx.x: The musicians are jealous of each other now. In fact, they are more ugly than most people will ever be, because they know a man can play, and they or he's a junkie, will say he can't play/ they do harm.

Now, we are in Paris and I said, I think I'd better go and see my people so, I come home. After seeing my mother and everything, I said, well -- but, while I was there it seemed, I felt that there was no more Negro bands playing jazz. They Blocked them out. All I was hearing was Benny Goodman and Harry James and Charlie Shivack and these people are great jazz kings and they said, well, we are swingin now and we've been swinging it hearing people swing; since I was a baby, I cut my teeth on / that's what Jelly…
